baseline_policy: Exact full main-branch tree immediately before the first linked project implementation merge, with all ancestor history. Only the current AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md instruction files are overlaid in a separate commit. Existing prototypes and prerequisites are intentionally retained.
reference_policy: Actual full merged main-branch tree frozen at project completion (tasks 1 and 2), or last included completed-issue merge (task 3). The interval includes unrelated work; never grade the whole-tree difference. Use the scoped rubric, linked PR ledger, final behavior, and tests. References may rely on unrelated refactors absent from the starting tree; accept solutions adapted to baseline architecture.
scope_note: Earlier prototypes and foundational LiveKit/prompt code are part of the starting application; the requested project must be completed on top of them.
